test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no improvement required, select ‘No improvement’.

The shopping mall is __more farther__ from my house than from my office.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the use of the word 'more farther' is incorrect.
 
• The word 'farther' itself implies a **comparative degree**, so using '**more' is redundant**.
 
• Therefore, the correct comparative form 'farther' should be used without 'more'.
 
 
• My cousins are going no** farther** in their studies.
 
 

Hence, the correct statement is ***The shopping mall is farther from my house than from my office*.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word **'farther'** is used to indicate** physical distance.**
 
• Another word, **'further'**, is used to i**ndicate metaphorical or figurative distance or to mean 'additional'**.
 
• **Example:** *She decided to investigate the matter** further.***
